uvConvention: Texture origin upper-left; U maps horizontal texture axis and V vertical texture axis; approved mesh back island is rotated relative to garment vertical.

material.normalRoughness: Retained from approved geometry GLB; no geometry/material slots changed.

artwork.description: Original AtelierX vector artwork for ATEL-1 v3: skull with one red iris/open eye socket, single nasal opening, defined jaw and teeth; no second eye socket.
artwork.externalAssets: None; artwork authored for this revision.

back.scale: Artwork expanded 15% from initial diagnostic placement for normal-viewer legibility; remains inside measured torso UV island.
back.orientation: Artwork is rotated +90° in texture space to compensate for the approved back UV island orientation; final browser capture confirms upright mark.
back.placement: Centered on lower back panel, below hood footprint and above hem. Only the back is printed.

status: Designer preview; product QA retest and Visual Studio integration pending.
